description: This Java class 'TbRpcService' provides RPC-related services, including saving RPCs, updating RPC status, and pushing RPC messages to the rule engine within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbRpcService
classes.description: Service class for managing RPCs, including saving, updating status, and message pushing within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an Rpc object and pushes a message to the rule engine.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Updates the status and response of an existing Rpc identified by RpcId, then pushes a message.

methods.name: pushRpcMsgToRuleEngine
methods.description: Constructs and sends an RPC message to the rule engine based on Rpc status.

methods.name: findRpcById
methods.description: Retrieves an Rpc by its ID.

methods.name: findAllByDeviceIdAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all RPCs for a device with a specific status, paginated.
